words.ex_cn: 许多学生申请政府补贴的学生贷款来支付学费。
words.en: Financial aid for students provided by the government to cover educational costs.

words.tr: phrase. 由政府补贴的租赁住房；指由政府提供财政支持以降低租金、供低收入群体居住的住房
words.ex: The poor family lives in government-subsidized rental housing.
words.ex_cn: 这个贫困家庭住在政府补贴的租赁住房中。
words.en: Rental housing projects supported by government funding to make housing more affordable.

words.w: crack down on organized crime and root out local criminal gangs
words.tr: 短语动词. 打击有组织犯罪并彻底铲除地方犯罪团伙
words.uk: /kræk daʊn ɒn ˈɔːrɡənaɪzd kraɪm ænd raʊt aʊt ˈləʊkəl kriːmɪnəl gæŋs/
words.us: /kræk daʊn ɑːn ˈɔːrɡənaɪzd kraɪm ænd raʊt aʊt ˈloʊkəl kriːmɪnəl gæŋz/
words.ex: The police will crack down on organized crime and root out local criminal gangs.
words.ex_cn: 警方将严厉打击有组织犯罪，并铲除本地犯罪团伙。
words.en: Targeted actions against organized crime syndicates and the elimination of local criminal groups.

words.tr: phrase. 电信与网络诈骗；指通过电信手段或互联网实施的欺诈行为
words.ex: He lost money to telecom and cyber fraud last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月被电信和网络诈骗骗了钱。
words.en: Fraudulent activities conducted via telecommunications networks and cyberspace, often involving financial scams or identity theft.

words.tr: phrase. 虚荣项目；指主要为满足个人虚荣心而非实际价值或公共利益而开展的项目
words.ex: He called it a vanity project because no one else cared.
words.ex_cn: 他称之为一个虚荣的项目，因为其他人根本不关心。
words.en: A project undertaken primarily for personal prestige or image-building rather than practical benefit.

words.tr: 名词短语. 电子许可证和证书
words.ex: He uses electronic licenses and certificates to work online.
words.ex_cn: 他使用电子许可证和证书在线工作。
words.en: Official permits and qualifications issued in digital format, often for professional or regulatory purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 人口普查；人口统计
words.ex: The government does a population census every ten years.
words.ex_cn: 政府每十年进行一次人口普查。
words.en: The official counting of all the people in a country at a particular time.

words.tr: phrase. 种子产业振兴；种业振兴
words.ex: The government supports the seed industry vitalization to improve crop yields.
words.ex_cn: 政府支持种业振兴以提高作物产量。
words.en: The strategic development and enhancement of the seed industry to ensure food security and agricultural innovation.

words.tr: phrase. 教育平等；指每个人无论背景如何，都有平等接受教育的权利和机会
words.ex: The school promotes educational equality for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校为所有学生促进教育平等。
words.en: Educational equality refers to the principle that all individuals should have equal access to education and the same opportunities to achieve their educational potential, regardless of their background, gender, ethnicity, or any other characteristic.

words.tr: phrase. 双一流倡议（指中国推动建设世界一流大学和一流学科的国家战略）
words.ex: The Double First-Class initiative aims to enhance the global competitiveness of Chinese universities.
words.ex_cn: 双一流计划旨在提升中国大学的全球竞争力。
words.en: The Double First-Class Initiative is a higher education development plan launched by the Chinese government to develop world-class universities and first-class disciplines.

words.tr: phrase. 职业技能培训；旨在提升特定职业所需实践能力的教育训练
words.ex: He joined vocational skills training to become a mechanic.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了职业技能培训，以成为一名机械师。
words.en: Education and instruction designed to equip individuals with specific competencies for particular occupations.

words.tr: phrase. 基本养老金；基础退休金
words.ex: He receives a basic pension after retiring.
words.ex_cn: 他退休后领取基本养老金。
words.en: A regular payment made by the state to citizens upon reaching retirement age, forming the foundation of their post-employment income.

words.tr: phrase. 完整的疫苗接种；指完成推荐的所有剂次的疫苗注射，以达到最佳免疫效果
words.ex: He has full vaccination against COVID-19.
words.ex_cn: 他已完全接种了新冠疫苗。
words.en: The state of having received all recommended doses of a vaccine to achieve full protection against a specific disease.

words.tr: phrase. 全面乡村振兴；指在经济、社会、文化、生态等各个方面全面推进农村地区的振兴与发展
words.ex: The government supports all round rural revitalization to improve life in villages.
words.ex_cn: 政府支持全面的乡村振兴，以改善乡村生活。
words.en: Comprehensive development of rural areas encompassing economic, social, cultural, and environmental dimensions.

words.w: directly settle medical expenses incurred outside of a patient's home province
words.tr: 短语. 直接结算患者在其家乡省份以外地区产生的医疗费用
words.ex: The hospital can directly settle medical expenses incurred outside of a patient's home province.
words.ex_cn: 医院可以直接结算患者在非户籍省份产生的医疗费用。
words.en: The process by which medical costs are reimbursed directly by a patient's home province's insurance system for treatment received elsewhere.

words.w: crack down on the trafficking of women and children
words.tr: 短语动词. 对拐卖妇女和儿童行为进行严厉打击
words.uk: kræk daʊn ɒn ðə traːfɪkɪŋ əv wɪmən ənd ˈtʃɪldrən
words.us: kræk daʊn ɑn ðə træfɪkɪŋ əv wɪmən ənd ˈtʃɪldrən
words.ex: The government will crack down on the trafficking of women and children.
words.ex_cn: 政府将严厉打击贩卖妇女和儿童的行为。
words.en: The vigorous enforcement of laws to eliminate the illegal trade and exploitation of women and children.

words.tr: phrase. 广泛的共识；普遍的一致意见
words.ex: There is a broad consensus that children should eat vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 人们普遍认为孩子应该吃蔬菜。
words.en: A general agreement among a wide range of people or groups.

words.tr: phrase. 志愿精神；志愿服务的精神
words.ex: He shows volunteer spirit by helping the old people.
words.ex_cn: 他通过帮助老人展现志愿精神。
words.en: A willingness to help others or contribute to a cause without expecting payment.

words.tr: phrase. 工业和信息化部（中国国务院组成部门，负责工业、通信业和信息化发展）
words.ex: The ministry of industry and information approved the new factory plan.
words.ex_cn: 工业和信息化部批准了新工厂计划。
words.en: A government department responsible for industrial and information technology policy.

words.w: spirit of the rule of law
words.tr: phrase. 法治精神；指尊重法律权威、依法治理社会的核心理念与价值
words.ex: He respects the spirit of the rule of law.
words.ex_cn: 他尊重法治的精神。
words.en: The fundamental principle that laws should govern a nation, ensuring fairness and justice.

words.tr: phrase. 无人工厂；指无需人工操作、由自动化设备或机器人运行的制造工厂
words.ex: The company opened an unmanned factory last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年开设了一家无人工厂。
words.en: A factory that operates with minimal human intervention, using automation and robotics.

words.tr: phrase. 世界粮食计划署
words.ex: The World Food Programme gives food to hungry children.
words.ex_cn: 世界粮食计划署向饥饿的儿童提供食物。
words.en: A United Nations agency that leads the global fight against hunger.

words.tr: phrase. 经济结构调整
words.ex: The government has implemented economic restructuring to improve the efficiency of industries.
words.ex_cn: 政府实施了经济结构调整以提高工业效率。
words.en: Economic restructuring refers to the process of changing the way an economy is organized, often to improve efficiency or adapt to new conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 国土资源部
words.ex: The ministry of land and resources approved the new project.
words.ex_cn: 国土资源部批准了这个新项目。
words.en: The Ministry of Land and Resources is a government department responsible for the management, planning, and protection of land and natural resources within a country.

words.tr: phrase. 文化遗产和历史遗迹
words.ex: The government protects cultural relics and historic sites.
words.ex_cn: 政府保护文物和历史遗址。
words.en: Places, objects, or structures of historical, cultural, or archaeological significance.

words.tr: phrase. 国家税务总局（中国负责税收征管的中央政府机构）
words.ex: The State Administration of Taxation collects taxes from businesses.
words.ex_cn: 国家税务总局向企业征税。
words.en: The government agency in China responsible for tax collection and administration.

words.tr: phrase. 信贷增长；信用扩张
words.ex: The bank reports strong credit growth this year.
words.ex_cn: 银行报告今年信贷增长强劲。
words.en: An increase in the amount of credit or loans extended by financial institutions.

words.tr: phrase. 亲善大使；友好使者（代表组织或国家促进友好关系、人道主义事业或公益活动的人）
words.ex: The celebrity was appointed as a goodwill ambassador to promote cultural exchange.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人被任命为友好大使，以促进文化交流。
words.en: A goodwill ambassador is a person who represents an organization, country, or cause in a positive light, often through public appearances and advocacy.

words.tr: phrase. 服务业；服务行业（指提供服务而非生产实物的经济部门）
words.ex: He works in the service industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在服务业工作。
words.en: The sector of the economy that provides services rather than goods.

words.tr: phrase. 股市崩盘
words.ex: The stock market crash made many people lose money.
words.ex_cn: 股市崩盘让许多人亏了钱。
words.en: A sudden and significant decline in the value of stocks traded on the stock market, often leading to widespread financial loss.

words.tr: phrase. 娱乐场所；演出场地
words.ex: Many people go to entertainment venues on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 很多人在周末去娱乐场所。
words.en: Places or establishments designed for public leisure and amusement, such as cinemas, theatres, or clubs.

words.tr: phrase. 数字化与智能化转型；指企业或组织通过数字技术和智能技术实现业务模式、流程和能力的全面升级与变革
words.ex: The company is doing digital and intelligent transformation to work faster.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司正在进行数字化和智能化转型，以更快地工作。
words.en: The process of integrating digital technologies and intelligent systems into business operations.

words.tr: phrase. 股票市场；证券市场（复数形式，指多个股票交易场所或整体股市）
words.ex: Stock markets go up and down every day.
words.ex_cn: 股票市场每天上下波动。
words.en: Public markets where company shares are bought and sold.

words.tr: phrase. 野生动物的栖息地；为野生动物提供生存环境的地方
words.ex: The park protects habitats for wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护野生动物的栖息地。
words.en: Natural environments where wild animals live, feed, and reproduce.

words.tr: phrase. 主权债券；由国家政府发行的债券
words.ex: The country sells sovereign bonds to raise money.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家出售主权债券来筹集资金。
words.en: Government-issued debt securities that are considered low-risk investments.

words.tr: phrase. 未来科学奖，一项表彰在大中华地区取得杰出科技成果的科学家的国际奖项
words.ex: He won the future science prize for his new discovery.
words.ex_cn: 他因新的发现获得了未来科学奖。
words.en: An award given in recognition of outstanding achievements in scientific research.

words.tr: phrase. 知识产权保护
words.ex: The law helps the protection of intellectual property rights.
words.ex_cn: 法律有助于保护知识产权。
words.en: Legal safeguards that protect creations of the mind, such as inventions and artistic works.

words.tr: phrase. 全球生物多样性保护；指在全球范围内保护各种生物物种及其生态系统，以维持生态平衡和可持续发展
words.ex: Governments work together for global biodiversity conservation.
words.ex_cn: 各国政府共同努力保护全球生物多样性。
words.en: The worldwide effort to protect and preserve the variety of life on Earth.

words.tr: phrase. 基本养老保险
words.ex: He pays for basic old-age insurance every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月都缴纳基本养老保险。
words.en: A state-provided pension scheme that offers a basic level of financial support to the elderly.

words.tr: phrase. 带薪休假；带薪年假
words.ex: He got paid vacation leave after working one year.
words.ex_cn: 他工作一年后获得了有薪休假。
words.en: A period of leave from work for which an employee continues to receive their regular pay.

words.tr:
n. 淡季
adj. 淡季的
adv. 淡季地
words.ex: He works as a coach in the off-season.
words.ex_cn: 他在休赛期当教练。
words.en: The off-season is the time of year when a particular place or activity is less busy or popular.

words.tr: phrase. 给予肯定或赞成的表示；竖起大拇指表示赞同
words.ex: He gives a thumbs-up when he likes the movie.
words.ex_cn: 当他喜欢这部电影时，他会竖起大拇指。
words.en: To express approval, agreement, or encouragement for something.

words.tr: n. 技艺；手艺；精工细作
words.ex: The craftsmanship of the wooden chair is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 这把木椅的工艺非常出色。
words.en: The skill involved in making things by hand.

words.tr: phrase. 创新创业人才
words.ex: The school trains innovational and entrepreneurial talent for start-ups.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校为初创企业培养创新和创业人才。
words.en: Individuals with exceptional abilities in innovation and entrepreneurship.

words.tr: phrase. 双一流建设倡议（指中国推动建设世界一流大学和一流学科的国家战略）
words.ex: The school launched a double-first class initiative to improve education.
words.ex_cn: 学校发起了一个双一流计划以改善教育。
words.en: A Chinese government initiative to develop world-class universities and disciplines.

words.tr: phrase. 直播经济；以实时视频直播为核心驱动力的线上商业生态，包括打赏、电商带货、广告、会员付费等多种变现模式
words.ex: Many people earn money through livestreaming economy by selling products online.
words.ex_cn: 许多人通过直播经济在线销售产品来赚钱。
words.en: An economic model based on real-time video broadcasting and digital interaction, often involving e-commerce and content creation.

words.tr: phrase. 可持续的海洋开发；指在保护海洋生态系统前提下，合理利用海洋资源以实现经济、社会和环境协调发展的过程
words.ex: The country promotes sustainable marine development to protect fish and oceans.
words.ex_cn: 该国推动可持续的海洋发展，以保护鱼类和海洋。
words.en: The practice of developing ocean resources in a way that maintains ecological balance and supports long-term economic and social needs.

words.tr: phrase. 高温补贴；指在高温环境下工作时，用人单位向劳动者发放的补助费用
words.ex: Workers in high-temperature environments are often entitled to high-temperature subsidies.
words.ex_cn: 在高温环境下工作的工人通常有权获得高温补贴。
words.en: Financial support provided to workers or entities to mitigate the effects of working in high-temperature environments.

words.tr: phrase. 美国联邦储备系统（美国的中央银行体系）
words.ex: The Federal Reserve plays a crucial role in the U.S. economy by setting monetary policy.
words.ex_cn: 联邦储备系统通过制定货币政策在美国经济中扮演着关键角色。
words.en: The Federal Reserve, often referred to as the Fed, is the central banking system of the United States, which regulates the U.S. monetary and financial system.

words.tr: phrase. 人道主义援助；为缓解人类苦难而提供的救援物资或支持
words.ex: The country sent humanitarian aid to the war zone.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家向战区运送了人道主义援助。
words.en: Humanitarian aid: Assistance provided to relieve suffering, often in emergencies, based on principles of humanity and impartiality.

words.tr: phrase. 社交礼仪与文明礼貌
words.ex: He follows social etiquette and civility in public places.
words.ex_cn: 他在公共场合遵守社会礼仪和文明行为。
words.en: The set of accepted behaviors and polite conduct that govern social interactions and promote mutual respect in society.

words.tr: phrase. 加息周期；利率上调循环
words.ex: The bank ended the rate hike cycle last month.
words.ex_cn: 银行上个月结束了加息周期。
words.en: A series of consecutive increases in interest rates by a central bank to control inflation or manage economic growth.

words.tr: phrase. 城市融合；指不同社会群体、文化或功能在城市空间中的整合与协调
words.ex: The city plans urban integration for new immigrants.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市计划为新移民实施城市融合。
words.en: The process of incorporating new developments or populations into existing urban areas, ensuring access to services and infrastructure.

words.tr: 名词短语：国家总体安全观，指全面、系统、综合地看待国家安全问题，涵盖政治、经济、军事、社会、网络等多方面安全的总体性视角
words.ex: The government takes a holistic view of national security.
words.ex_cn: 政府对国家安全采取全面的视角。
words.en: A comprehensive approach to national security that considers military, economic, social, and environmental factors as interconnected.

words.tr: n. 电子通信（electronic communication）的缩写
words.ex: He uses an e-c to pay for his lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他用电子现金支付午餐。
words.en: An abbreviation for 'electronic commerce,' referring to commercial transactions conducted over the internet.

words.tr: phrase. 中国人民解放军成立95周年纪念日
words.ex: The army held a parade for the 95th founding anniversary of PLA.
words.ex_cn: 军队为中国人民解放军成立95周年举行了阅兵。
words.en: The 95th anniversary of the founding of the People's Liberation Army of China, celebrated in 2022.

words.tr: phrase. 石油输出国组织（简称OPEC，由主要石油出口国组成的政府间国际组织，旨在协调和统一成员国的石油政策）
words.ex: OPEC controls the price of oil by managing production.
words.ex_cn: 欧佩克通过管理产量来控制油价。
words.en: An intergovernmental organization established in 1960 to coordinate and unify petroleum policies among member countries to secure fair prices.

words.tr: phrase. 美联储
words.ex: The federal reserve lowers interest rates to help the economy.
words.ex_cn: 美联储降低利率以帮助经济。
words.en: The Federal Reserve, often referred to as the Fed, is the central banking system of the United States. It was created to provide the country with a safe, flexible, and stable monetary and financial system.

words.tr: adj. 特别的；临时的；为特定目的安排的
words.ex: The committee was formed on an ad-hoc basis to address the immediate issue.
words.ex_cn: 这个委员会是为了解决眼前的问题临时成立的。
words.en: adjective. created or done for a particular purpose as necessary.

words.tr: phrase. 诺贝尔奖获得者
words.ex: Marie Curie was the first woman to become a Nobel laureate.
words.ex_cn: 玛丽·居里是第一位成为诺贝尔奖得主的女性。
words.en: A Nobel laureate is a person who has been awarded a Nobel Prize, which is one of the most prestigious international awards given for achievements in physics, chemistry, medicine, literature, peace, and economics.

words.tr: phrase. 零和博弈；零和游戏（指一方的收益等于另一方的损失，总和为零的博弈情形）
words.ex: The competition is a zero sum game where one wins and the other loses.
words.ex_cn: 这场竞争是一个零和游戏，一方赢，另一方输。
words.en: A situation in which one party's gain is equivalent to another's loss, meaning no net benefit is created for the participants.

words.w: the House of the Lords  the House of the Representatives
words.tr: phrase. 上议院与下议院（英国议会的两个议院）
words.uk: ðə haʊs əv ðə lɔːdz ðə haʊs əv ðə reprezəntətɪvz
words.us: ðə haʊs əv ðə lɔːrdz ðə haʊs əv ðə repriˈzentətɪvz
words.ex: The House of the Lords and the House of the Representatives make laws together.
words.ex_cn: 上议院和下议院一起制定法律。
words.en: The upper chamber of the UK Parliament, where members are appointed or hereditary, and the lower chamber of the US Congress, where members are elected by the people.

words.tr: phrase. 自愿捐款；自愿捐赠；自愿提供的贡献
words.ex: He made a voluntary contribution to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他向慈善机构做了自愿捐款。
words.en: A donation or payment given freely, without legal obligation or coercion, often to support a cause or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 循环碳经济；一种旨在通过减少、再利用、回收和去除二氧化碳来实现碳资源可持续利用的经济模式
words.ex: The country is building a circular carbon economy to reduce waste.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在建立一个循环碳经济以减少浪费。
words.en: An economic model that minimizes waste and pollution by reusing, recycling, and regenerating materials and energy in a closed-loop system.

words.tr: phrase. 临终关怀；为绝症患者提供的舒缓治疗和护理服务
words.ex: The old man received hospice care at home.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人在家接受了临终关怀。
words.en: Specialized care for terminally ill patients focusing on comfort, pain management, and quality of life rather than cure, typically provided by an interdisciplinary team.

words.tr: phrase. 劳动力短缺；用工荒
words.ex: The company faces a workforce crunch because too few people want to work.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司面临劳动力短缺，因为太少了人愿意工作。
words.en: A significant shortage of skilled or available workers in a particular industry or economy, often due demographic shifts, migration, or changing job preferences.

words.tr: phrase. 消除文盲；根除不识字现象
words.ex: The government wants to eliminate illiteracy by building more schools.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望通过建设更多学校来消除文盲。
words.en: To eliminate illiteracy means to eradicate the inability to read or write in a certain population, often through educational programs.

words.tr: phrase. 司法公信力；司法可信度
words.ex: The judge has high judicial credibility.
words.ex_cn: 这位法官具有很高的司法公信力。
words.en: The public trust and perceived fairness in a country's legal system and its judges, essential for the rule of law and social stability.

words.tr: phrase. 机场候机楼
words.ex: He waited at the airport terminal for his flight.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场航站楼等他的航班。
words.en: The building at an airport where passengers transfer between ground transportation and the facilities that allow them to board and disembark from aircraft.

words.tr: phrase. 出口配额（政府对出口商品数量或价值所设定的限制）
words.ex: The country sets export quotas to control how much rice leaves the country.
words.ex_cn: 该国设定出口配额以控制大米出口量。
words.en: Government-imposed limits on the quantity of specific goods that can be exported to other countries, often to protect domestic supply or manage trade balances.

words.tr: phrase. 双重合同；同时签订的两份合同，通常指在特定法律或商业情境下具有互补或并行效力的两个协议
words.ex: The company was found to have used dual contracts to avoid taxes.
words.ex_cn: 该公司被发现使用阴阳合同来避税。
words.en: A contract that involves two distinct parties or two separate agreements, often used in legal or business contexts.

words.tr: n. 民族主义；国家主义；
words.ex: Nationalism made people proud of their own country.
words.ex_cn: 民族主义让人们为自己的国家感到自豪。
words.en: Nationalism is a political, social, and economic ideology and movement characterized by the promotion of the interests of a particular nation, especially with the aim of gaining and maintaining the nation's sovereignty over its homeland.

words.tr: phrase. 浏览量；观看次数（通常用于统计网页、视频等内容被查看的次数）
words.ex: The video has high view counts.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频的观看次数很高。
words.en: The number of times a piece of digital content, such as a video or article, has been viewed by users, used as a metric for popularity or reach.

words.tr: phrase. 全球经济动荡； worldwide instability in economic conditions
words.ex: Many countries suffered during the global economic turmoil.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家在全球经济动荡期间遭受了损失。
words.en: Widespread instability and uncertainty in the world's financial and commercial systems, often caused by recessions, geopolitical conflicts, or major policy shifts.

words.tr: phrase. 美国海关与边境保护局（美国联邦机构，负责监管进出口、征收关税及保护边境安全）
words.ex: She showed her passport to US Customs and Border Protection.
words.ex_cn: 她向美国海关和边境保护局出示了护照。
words.en: The U.S. federal law enforcement agency responsible for monitoring and controlling the flow of people and goods across the nation's borders, including customs and immigration.

words.tr: phrase. 首次公开募股
words.ex: The company's Initial Public Offering was a huge success.
words.ex_cn: 该公司的首次公开发行取得了巨大成功。
words.en: An initial public offering (IPO) refers to the process of offering shares of a private corporation to the public in a new stock issuance.

words.tr: phrase. 转基因食品；经过基因改造的食品
words.ex: Many people are concerned about the safety of genetically-modified food.
words.ex_cn: 许多人对转基因食品的安全性表示担忧。
words.en: Food derived from organisms whose genetic material has been altered using biotechnology.

words.tr: phrase. 负责任的利益相关者；承担责任的利益攸关方
words.ex: China is a responsible stakeholder in global climate talks.
words.ex_cn: 中国是全球气候谈判中的负责任利益相关方。
words.en: A business or entity that actively engages with and contributes to the long-term health of the industries and societies in which it operates, beyond just seeking profit.

words.tr: phrase. 最先进的技术；尖端科技
words.ex: The company invested heavily in state-of-the-art technology to stay competitive.
words.ex_cn: 为了保持竞争力，该公司在尖端技术上投入了大量资金。
words.en: The most recent stage in the development of a product, incorporating the newest ideas and features.

words.tr: phrase. 研究伦理；科研道德规范
words.ex: The students must follow research ethics in their project.
words.ex_cn: 学生在他们的项目中必须遵守研究伦理。
words.en: Ethical principles governing the conduct of research, ensuring integrity, objectivity, and respect for participants.

words.tr: phrase. 创造公平竞争环境；使各方处于同等地位；消除不平等条件
words.ex: The new law helps to level the playing field for small businesses.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律帮助为小企业创造公平的竞争环境。
words.en: To make conditions fair and equal for all participants in a competition or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 制度保障；体制保障；由机构提供的正式担保
words.ex: The bank requires an institutional guarantee for the loan.
words.ex_cn: 银行要求提供机构担保才能发放贷款。
words.en: A formal assurance or commitment provided by an organization or institution to ensure certain standards or outcomes.

words.tr: phrase. 可行性研究
words.ex: Before starting the project, a feasibility study was conducted to assess its viability.
words.ex_cn: 在启动项目之前，进行了可行性研究以评估其可行性。
words.en: A feasibility study is an assessment of the practicality of a proposed project or system.

words.tr: 短语：良性循环与恶性循环；benign 和 virtuous circles 指带来积极结果的正向循环，vicious circles 指导致负面结果的负向循环
words.ex: He made a benign circle of friends who helped him grow.
words.ex_cn: 他交了一群善良的朋友，帮助他成长。
words.en: A term describing the self-reinforcing cycles of positive (virtuous) or negative (vicious) outcomes in systems or processes.

words.tr: phrase. 区域热点；地区热点地区；区域冲突高发区
words.ex: These regional hotspots have many tourists in summer.
words.ex_cn: 这些地区热点在夏天有很多游客。
words.en: Specific geographic areas that experience intense activity, concentration, or development in a particular field.

words.tr: phrase. 总体规划；总计划；蓝图；周密方案
words.ex: He made a master plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个储蓄的总体规划。
words.en: A comprehensive and strategic plan that outlines the main objectives and steps for achieving a large-scale goal.

words.tr: phrase. 行动守则
words.ex: The school has a code of conduct for all students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为所有学生制定了行为准则。
words.en: A set of rules or standards governing behavior within an organization or group.

words.tr: phrase. 全球碳计划，一个致力于研究全球碳循环及其与气候变化关系的国际科研合作项目
words.ex: The global carbon project tracks carbon emissions worldwide.
words.ex_cn: 全球碳项目追踪全球的碳排放。
words.en: An international initiative focused on understanding and addressing the causes and effects of climate change through carbon management.

words.tr: phrase. 产权公司；负责处理房地产产权调查、保险及过户手续的公司
words.ex: The title company checked the house papers.
words.ex_cn: 产权公司检查了房屋文件。
words.en: A company that provides services related to the transfer of property ownership, including title searches and insurance.

words.tr: phrase. 信贷紧缩；信用危机（指银行减少贷款导致资金紧张的经济现象）
words.ex: Many banks stopped lending during the credit crunch.
words.ex_cn: 在信贷紧缩期间，许多银行停止了放贷。
words.en: A sudden reduction in the availability of money or credit from banks and lenders, often leading to economic difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 国际收支平衡；指一国在一定时期内与其他国家之间的全部经济交易的系统记录，包括经常账户、资本账户和金融账户的总和
words.ex: The country works to keep the balance of international payment stable.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家努力保持国际收支平衡。
words.en: A statistical record of all monetary transactions between a country and the rest of the world over a period.

words.tr: phrase. 国民待遇原则：在国际贸易法中，指缔约一方给予另一方自然人、法人、产品、服务或投资的待遇不得低于其给予本国同类对象的待遇
words.ex: The country follows the national treatment principle for foreign companies.
words.ex_cn: 该国对外资企业实行国民待遇原则。
words.en: A principle in international trade law requiring that foreign companies be treated no less favorably than domestic companies.

words.tr: phrase. 公共物品；公共益品；具有非排他性和非竞争性的商品或服务，如国防、灯塔、清洁空气等
words.ex: Clean air is a public good.
words.ex_cn: 清洁的空气是一种公共物品。
words.en: A good or service that is non-excludable and non-rivalrous, meaning it is available to all members of a society without reducing its availability to others, such as national defense or clean air.

words.tr: phrase. 规模经济；大规模生产带来的成本优势
words.ex: Large factories have economies of scale and make goods cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 大型工厂具有规模经济，能以更低的价格生产商品。
words.en: Economies of scale refer to the cost advantage that arises with increased output of a product. This occurs because the cost per unit of output generally decreases with increasing scale as fixed costs are spread out over more units of output.

words.tr: phrase. 非法占地者聚居区；指未经官方许可、擅自占用土地搭建的贫民居住区
words.ex: Many poor families live in a squatter settlement near the city.
words.ex_cn: 许多贫困家庭住在城市附近的非法棚户区。
words.en: An area of unauthorized housing, typically in urban areas, where people build makeshift shelters on land they do not own or rent, often lacking basic services.

words.tr: phrase. 提供的住房基金；指由单位或政府为员工或居民提供的用于住房的专项资金
words.ex: The government provided housing fund for low-income families.
words.ex_cn: 政府为低收入家庭提供了住房资金。
words.en: A fund that provides financial assistance for housing costs, such as rent or mortgage payments, often for low-income individuals or families.

words.tr: phrase. 权力滥用；滥用职权
words.ex: He was fired for power abuse.
words.ex_cn: 他因滥用权力被解雇了。
words.en: The misuse of authority or influence for personal gain or to harm others, often in a professional or institutional context.

words.tr: phrase. 不良贷款；不良资产；指不能按合同约定产生收益或已停止付息的资产
words.ex: The bank closed the loan because it became a non-performing asset.
words.ex_cn: 银行关闭了这笔贷款，因为它变成了不良资产。
words.en: A loan or investment that is not generating income for the lender, typically because the borrower has defaulted on payments.

words.tr: phrase. 受污染的；被玷污的 + n. 艺人；演艺人员 → 指名声受损或道德有污点的演艺人员
words.ex: The tainted entertainers lost their sponsors.
words.ex_cn: 那些声誉受损的艺人失去了赞助商。
words.en: Entertainers whose public image or career has been damaged by scandal, controversy, or unethical behavior, often leading to public backlash or professional decline.

words.tr: phrase. 对收视率的过度关注
words.ex: The show has an excessive focus on viewership, not quality.
words.ex_cn: 这个节目过于关注收视率，而不是质量。
words.en: An excessive preoccupation with the number of people watching or engaging with one's content.

words.tr: phrase. 稀土；稀土元素（指元素周期表中的镧系元素及钪、钇等共17种金属元素的总称）
words.ex: Rare earths are critical in the production of many high-tech devices.
words.ex_cn: 稀土元素在许多高科技设备的制造中起着关键作用。
words.en: Rare earths are a group of seventeen chemical elements in the periodic table, specifically the fifteen lanthanides plus scandium and yttrium. They are used in a wide range of high-tech applications, including electronics, clean energy, aerospace, automotive, and defense.

words.tr: phrase. 就业歧视；职场歧视
words.ex: He faced job discrimination because of his age.
words.ex_cn: 他因年龄而遭遇就业歧视。
words.en: Job discrimination refers to unfair treatment of an employee or job applicant based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age (40 or older), disability or genetic information.

words.w: the threshold for individual income tax
words.tr: phrase. 个人所得税起征点
words.uk: ðə ˈθreʃəld fɔː ˈɪndɪvɪdʒuəl ˈɪnkɒm tæks
words.us: ðə ˈθrɛʃəld fɔr ˈɪndɪvɪdʒuəl ˈɪŋkɑm tækz
words.ex: The threshold for individual income tax is 5,000 yuan per month.
words.ex_cn: 个人所得税的起征点是每月5000元。
words.en: The income level at which an individual becomes liable to pay income tax.

words.tr: phrase. 贫困发生率；贫困人口比例；衡量生活在贫困线以下人口占总人口百分比的指标
words.ex: The poverty headcount ratio dropped last year.
words.ex_cn: 贫困人数比例去年下降了。
words.en: The percentage of a population living below the poverty line, typically defined by a national or international income threshold.

words.tr: phrase. 临界点；转折点；引发重大变化的关键点
words.ex: The water reached the tipping point and started to overflow.
words.ex_cn: 水达到了临界点，开始溢出。
words.en: The point at which a series of small changes or incidents becomes significant enough to cause a larger, more important change.

words.tr: phrase. 文化默认设置；指在特定文化中被普遍接受或默认的行为模式、价值观或假设
words.ex: In many countries, shaking hands is a cultural default.
words.ex_cn: 在许多国家，握手是一种文化默认行为。
words.en: An assumption or belief that is so widely accepted within a particular culture that it is taken for granted and not explicitly stated or questioned.

words.tr: phrase. 关税；进口税
words.ex: He paid customs duty for the new phone.
words.ex_cn: 他为新手机支付了关税。
words.en: A customs duty is a tax imposed on goods when they are transported across international borders.

words.tr: phrase. 青少年犯罪
words.ex: The city is trying to reduce juvenile delinquency with after-school programs.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市正通过课后项目来减少青少年犯罪。
words.en: Juvenile delinquency refers to the participation in illegal behavior by minors (juveniles) who fall under a statutory age limit.

words.tr: phrase. 预期寿命；平均寿命
words.ex: Life expectancy has increased in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家的预期寿命已经增加。
words.en: The average period that a person may expect to live.

words.tr: phrase. 珍稀野生动物
words.ex: Farmers see rare wild animals near the forest at night.
words.ex_cn: 农民在晚上看到森林附近稀有的野生动物。
words.en: Animals that are not commonly seen or found in the wild, often due to low population numbers or specific habitats.

words.tr: phrase. 国际化的城市；具有多元文化和全球特征的大都市
words.ex: New York is a cosmopolitan city with people from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 纽约是一个来自许多国家的人们聚集的国际化城市。
words.en: A large, diverse city with a global population and cultural influences.

words.tr: phrase. 山洪暴发灾害；突发性洪水灾难
words.ex: The heavy rain caused a flash flood disaster in the village.
words.ex_cn: 暴雨在村庄引发了突发性洪水灾难。
words.en: A sudden, severe flood causing widespread damage and loss of life.

words.tr: n. 滞胀
words.ex: The country faced stagflation with high unemployment and rising prices.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家面临滞胀，失业率高且物价上涨。
words.en: Stagflation is an economic condition characterized by slow economic growth and relatively high unemployment, or economic stagnation, accompanied by rising prices, or inflation.

words.tr: phrase. 任命并授权；指派并赋予权力
words.ex: The boss appoints her and empowers her to lead the team.
words.ex_cn: 老板任命她并授权她领导团队。
words.en: To officially assign a role or position and grant the necessary authority.

words.tr: phrase. 气象灾害；由极端天气或气候事件（如台风、干旱、暴雨、热浪等）造成的灾难
words.ex: The meteorological disaster destroyed many homes.
words.ex_cn: 这场气象灾害摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A disaster caused by severe weather conditions like storms or droughts.

words.tr: phrase. 页数统计；页面计数
words.ex: The book has high page counts.
words.ex_cn: 这本书页数很多。
words.en: The number of pages in a document, book, or manuscript.

words.tr: phrase. 观众收视率；听众或观众对节目受欢迎程度的评价
words.ex: The show's audience rating has been steadily increasing.
words.ex_cn: 该节目的收视率一直在稳步上升。
words.en: The percentage of the total number of households or individuals tuned to a specific television or radio program at a given time.

words.tr: phrase. 年夜饭
words.ex: We have a family reunion dinner every New Year.
words.ex_cn: 我们每年春节都举行家庭团聚晚宴。
words.en: A meal shared by family members who have gathered together, often for a special occasion.

words.tr: n. 电子杂志
words.ex: I read an interesting article in an e-zine yesterday.
words.ex_cn: n. 我昨天在一本电子杂志上读到了一篇有趣的文章。
words.en: An e-zine is a magazine that is published in electronic form, especially on the internet.

words.tr: n. 金融科技（即 financial technology，指突破传统金融服务方式的高新技术）
words.ex: He works in a fintech company that helps people pay online.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家帮助人们在线支付的金融科技公司工作。
words.en: Financial technology, often shortened to fintech, is the technology and innovation that aims to compete with traditional financial methods in the delivery of financial services.

words.tr: n. 低头族
words.ex: The phubber was so engrossed in his phone that he missed his stop.
words.ex_cn: 那个低头族太专注于他的手机，以至于错过了他的站。
words.en: A person who ignores their companions in favor of their mobile phone, especially in social settings.

words.tr: phrase. 社交泡泡；指在疫情期间限定的、可安全互动的小范围社交群体
words.ex: He stays in his social bubble and rarely talks to others.
words.ex_cn: 他待在自己的社交圈里，很少与别人交流。
words.en: A small, close-knit social group formed for mutual support, especially during isolation.

words.tr: n. 电视成瘾者
words.ex: He is a teleholic who watches TV all day.
words.ex_cn: 他是个电视迷，整天看电视。
words.en: A person who is excessively addicted to using the telephone or mobile devices.

words.tr: phrase. 减轻基层官员负担
words.uk: rɪˈdjuːs ˈbɜːdnz ɒn kəˈmjuːnəti ˈlevl ˈɒfɪʃəlz
words.us: rɪˈduːs ˈbɜːrdnz ɑːn kəˈmjuːnəti ˈlɛvəl ˈɑːfɪʃəlz
words.ex: The new policy aims to reduce burdens on community-level officials.
words.ex_cn: 新政策旨在减轻基层官员的负担。
words.en: Measures to lessen the workload and administrative pressure on grassroots officials.

words.tr: phrase. 山洪；突发性洪水
words.ex: Heavy rain caused flash floods in the valley.
words.ex_cn: 暴雨引发了山谷里的突发性洪水。
words.en: Sudden, violent floods caused by heavy rain.

words.tr: phrase. 绩效评估；工作表现评价；业绩考核
words.ex: The company conducts performance appraisals every year to evaluate employees' work.
words.ex_cn: 公司每年进行绩效评估以评价员工的工作。
words.en: A performance appraisal is a systematic and periodic process that assesses an individual employee's job performance and productivity in relation to certain pre-established criteria and organizational objectives.

words.tr: phrase. 迁移贫困人口；将贫困人群迁往他处
words.ex: The government is relocating the poor to new housing.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在将穷人迁往新的住房。
words.en: The process of moving low-income individuals to different residential areas.

words.tr: phrase. 水力资源；水能资源（指可用于发电的水流能量）
words.ex: The country uses its hydropower resources to make electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家利用其水力资源来发电。
words.en: Natural resources, such as rivers or dams, used to generate electricity.

words.tr: phrase. 能源结构；能源组合（指一个国家或地区所使用的各种能源来源的比例，如煤炭、石油、天然气、核能、可再生能源等）
words.ex: The country is changing its energy mix to include more solar power.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在改变其能源结构，以增加更多太阳能。
words.en: The combination of different energy sources, like fossil fuels, renewables, and nuclear, used to meet a region's needs.

words.tr: phrase. 能源密集型的；耗能高的
words.ex: This factory is energy intensive.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂耗能很高。
words.en: Requiring a large amount of energy to operate or produce.

words.tr: phrase. 能源密集型产品；高能耗产品，指在生产过程中消耗大量能源的商品
words.ex: These products are energy-consuming intensive products.
words.ex_cn: 这些产品是耗能密集型产品。
words.en: Products that demand a high level of energy during their manufacturing process.

words.tr: phrase. 节能高效产品；指在使用过程中能够有效节约能源并具有高能效的各类产品
words.ex: They buy energy-saving efficient products to lower electricity bills.
words.ex_cn: 他们购买节能高效的产品来降低电费。
words.en: Products designed to use minimal energy while maintaining high performance.

words.tr: phrase. 劳动密集型的；需要大量人力的
words.ex: The manufacturing process is labor intensive, requiring many workers.
words.ex_cn: 这个制造过程是劳动密集型的，需要很多工人。
words.en: Requiring a large amount of labor to produce.

words.tr: phrase. 工厂关闭；工厂停工（指工厂停止运营或停产的现象）
words.ex: The factory closures caused many workers to lose their jobs.
words.ex_cn: 工厂关闭导致许多工人失业。
words.en: The permanent shutdown of manufacturing plants or industrial sites.

words.tr: phrase. 失业人数；职位流失
words.ex: The factory closed, and there were many job losses.
words.ex_cn: 工厂关闭了，造成了很多失业。
words.en: The reduction in the number of people employed, often due to economic downturns or automation.

words.w: migrant workers return to their home villages .
words.tr: phrase. 外来务工人员返回他们的家乡村庄
words.uk: ˈmaɪɡrənt ˈwɜːkəz rɪˈtɜːn tuː ðeə həʊm ˈvɪlɪdz
words.us: ˈmaɪɡrənt ˈwɜrkərz rɪˈtɜːrn tu ði r ˈvɪlɪdz
words.ex: Migrant workers return to their home villages in winter.
words.ex_cn: 农民工在冬天返回他们的家乡村庄。
words.en: Workers who move to other countries for employment returning to their native towns or villages.

words.tr: phrase. 基础设施；公共基础设施设施（如交通、供水、电力、通信等）
words.ex: The town needs better infrastructural facilities like roads and water pipes.
words.ex_cn: 这个城镇需要更好的基础设施，比如道路和水管。
words.en: Basic physical and organizational structures needed for the operation of a society, such as roads, power supplies, and water systems.

words.tr: phrase. 铁路公共大众运输交通系统
words.ex: The rail public mass transport transit is fast and cheap.
words.ex_cn: 铁路公共交通快捷又便宜。
words.en: A system of trains, buses, or other vehicles available to the public for mass transportation.

words.tr: phrase. 财政赤字；资金短缺；财务不足
words.ex: The school has a financial shortfall this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年学校资金不足。
words.en: A deficit in funds or a lack of necessary financial resources.

words.tr: phrase. 不确定性；不稳定因素；不稳定性
words.ex: The uncertainties and destabilizing factors caused instabilities in the economy.
words.ex_cn: 不确定性和 destabilizing 因素导致了经济的不稳定。
words.en: Elements or events that cause instability, unpredictability, or a lack of security in a system or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 社区层面；指在某一特定社区范围内进行的活动、干预或评估等
words.ex: The project works at the community level.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目在社区层面开展。
words.en: The level at which a group of people sharing common interests or characteristics interact and function.

words.tr: phrase. 遭受灾难的地区；受灾地区
words.ex: Volunteers sent food to disaster stricken areas.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者向受灾地区运送了食物。
words.en: Regions severely affected by a catastrophic event, such as a natural disaster or conflict.

words.tr: n. 水库；蓄水池；
words.ex: The reservoir provides water for the nearby town.
words.ex_cn: 这个水库为附近的城镇提供水源。
words.en: A reservoir is a large quantity of a substance that is stored and can be used when needed.

words.tr: phrase. 电网；电力网；供电网络
words.ex: The power grid failed during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间电网瘫痪了。
words.en: A power grid is a network that delivers electricity from producers to consumers. It includes generating stations that produce electrical power, high voltage transmission lines that carry power from distant sources to demand centers, and distribution lines that connect individual customers.

words.tr: phrase. 国内生产总值，即一个国家在特定时期内所有最终产品和服务的市场价值总和，用于衡量经济产出
words.ex: The country's GDP economic output increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的GDP经济产出去年增加了。
words.en: The total monetary value of all goods and services produced within a country over a specific period.

words.tr: phrase. 人力资本；指个体所拥有的知识、技能、教育和经验等能够创造经济价值的无形资产
words.ex: Investing in human capital is crucial for economic growth.
words.ex_cn: 对人力资本的投资对经济增长至关重要。
words.en: Human capital refers to the skills, knowledge, and experience possessed by an individual or population, viewed in terms of their value or cost to an organization or country.

words.tr: phrase. 人口结构的变化；指人口在年龄、性别、出生率、死亡率、迁移等方面发生的长期变动
words.ex: The city is preparing for demographic change.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市正在为人口结构变化做准备。
words.en: A change in the structure of a population, such as age, gender, or ethnicity, over time.

words.tr: phrase. 全面的、均衡发展的、以能力为导向的教育
words.uk: ˈhɒlɪstɪk wɛl rʌnd ˈkɒmpətəns ˈɔːrɪəntɪd ˌedʒuˈkeɪʃn
words.us: ˈhɑːləstɪk wɛl rʌnd ˈkɑːmpətəns ˈɔːrɪəntɪd ˌɛdʒuˈkeɪʃn
words.ex: The school offers a holistic, well-rounded, competence-oriented education.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校提供全面、均衡、以能力为导向的教育。
words.en: An educational approach that develops students' comprehensive abilities, focusing on well-rounded personal growth and practical skills.

words.w: the scientific literacy of the nation
words.tr: phrase. 国民的科学素养
words.uk: ðə ˈaɪsɪəntɪfɪk ˈlɪtəsi əv ðə ˈneɪʃn
words.us: ðə ˈaɪsəntɪfɪk ˈlɪtərəsi əv ðə ˈneɪʃn
words.ex: The scientific literacy of the nation helps people understand health news.
words.ex_cn: 国家的科学素养帮助人们理解健康新闻。
words.en: The collective ability of a population to understand and apply scientific concepts and critical thinking.

words.tr: phrase. 免费九年义务教育
words.uk: / friː naɪn jɪə r kɒmpʌlsəri ˌedʒʊˈkeɪʃən /
words.ex: The government provides free nine-year compulsory education for all children.
words.ex_cn: 政府为所有儿童提供九年免费义务教育。
words.en: A government-funded education system providing nine years of free, mandatory schooling for all children.

words.tr: phrase. 全球政治与经济格局；指世界各国在政治和经济方面的总体分布与相互关系
words.ex: The global political and economic landscape is changing fast.
words.ex_cn: 全球政治和经济格局正在迅速变化。
words.en: The interconnected global system of political power dynamics and economic relationships between nations.

words.tr: 短语：证券交易所恢复（指股市从下跌或危机中回升）
words.ex: The stock exchange recover after the crash.
words.ex_cn: 股市在崩盘后恢复了。
words.en: The recovery of a financial market where securities are bought and sold, indicating a rebound from a downturn.

words.tr: phrase. 一种积极主动的财政政策，指政府通过增加支出或减税等手段主动干预经济，以促进经济增长或应对经济下行压力
words.ex: The government uses a proactive fiscal policy to create jobs.
words.ex_cn: 政府采用积极的财政政策来创造就业。
words.en: A government strategy using increased public spending and tax cuts to stimulate economic growth during a recession.

words.tr: phrase. 审慎的货币政策；指在控制货币供应和利率方面采取谨慎、稳健措施的经济政策
words.ex: The bank uses a prudent monetary policy to control inflation.
words.ex_cn: 银行采用谨慎的货币政策来控制通货膨胀。
words.en: A central bank's approach to managing the economy by adjusting interest rates and money supply to control inflation and support growth.

words.tr: phrase. 宏观经济；总体经济（研究整个国家或地区的经济总量、增长、就业、通货膨胀等宏观现象的经济学分支）
words.ex: The government studies macro economy to improve jobs.
words.ex_cn: 政府研究宏观经济以改善就业。
words.en: The study of the economy as a whole, focusing on aggregate indicators like GDP, inflation, and unemployment, rather than individual markets or firms.

words.tr: phrase. 不合格生产；不符合规格的、有缺陷的产品生产
words.ex: The factory found substandard production nonconforming defective production in the last batch.
words.ex_cn: 工厂在上一批产品中发现了不符合标准的、有缺陷的生产。
words.en: Production that fails to meet established quality standards or specifications.

words.tr: phrase. 加工食品；经过工业处理的食品
words.ex: He avoids processed food because it is unhealthy.
words.ex_cn: 他避免吃加工食品，因为它不健康。
words.en: Processed food refers to food items that have been altered from their natural state for safety reasons or convenience, often through canning, freezing, refrigeration, dehydration, or aseptic processing.

words.tr: phrase. 可测量的指标；可量化的指示器
words.ex: Weight is a measurable indicator of health.
words.ex_cn: 体重是健康的一个可衡量指标。
words.en: A quantifiable measure used to assess the extent or degree of something, often used in research or business contexts.

words.tr: phrase. 国际扫盲日（每年9月8日，由联合国教科文组织设立，旨在提高全球识字率）
words.ex: Schools celebrate international literacy day every year.
words.ex_cn: 学校每年庆祝国际扫盲日。
words.en: A United Nations observance day held annually on September 8 to highlight the importance of literacy and promote education as a fundamental human right.

words.tr: phrase. 节能的；节约能源的
words.ex: This lamp is energy-efficient and saves energy.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯节能且省电。
words.en: Relating to or designed to use less energy while performing the same function, often to reduce costs and environmental impact.

words.tr: phrase. 良好实践；公认的正确做法
words.ex: It is good practice to check your answers.
words.ex_cn: 检查你的答案是好的做法。
words.en: A recommended or standard method or procedure that is widely accepted as effective, safe, or ethical in a particular field or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 相称的薪酬；与工作量、责任或资历相匹配的报酬
words.ex: He got commensurate remuneration for his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他因努力工作获得了相称的报酬。
words.en: Payment that is appropriate and fair in relation to the work, experience, or responsibilities involved.

words.tr: phrase. 联合国粮食及农业组织（联合国下属机构，负责全球粮食安全和农业发展）
words.ex: The food and agriculture organization helps farmers grow more food.
words.ex_cn: 联合国粮食及农业组织帮助农民种植更多粮食。
words.en: A United Nations agency that leads international efforts to defeat hunger and improve nutrition and agriculture.

words.tr: phrase. 治理方法；指组织或机构在管理、决策和监督方面所采用的系统性方式或策略
words.ex: The school uses a new governance approach to make decisions.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校采用了一种新的治理方式来做决定。
words.en: A method or strategy for directing and controlling an organization, system, or society, typically involving structures, processes, and principles to ensure accountability, transparency, and effective decision-making.

words.tr: phrase. 儒家思想和道教；分别指以孔子思想为核心的儒家学说和以老子、庄子为代表的道家哲学体系
words.ex: Confucianism and Taoism are old Chinese philosophies.
words.ex_cn: 儒家和道家是古老的中国哲学。
words.en: A Chinese philosophical tradition emphasizing moral order, filial piety, and social harmony, based on the teachings of Confucius and his followers.

words.tr: phrase. 人与自然的和谐；人类与自然界之间的平衡与协调
words.ex: The villagers live in harmony between man and nature.
words.ex_cn: 村民们与自然和谐共处。
words.en: A state of balanced coexistence and mutual respect between humanity and the natural world.

words.w: rely soly on one ' s own exploration is a dead end .
words.tr: phrase. 依靠；依赖；指望；
words.ex: Relying solely on one's own exploration is a dead end.
words.ex_cn: 仅仅依靠自己的探索是走不通的。
words.en: Depending exclusively on personal discovery without external guidance leads to failure or stagnation.

words.tr: phrase. 能源出口消费结构；指一个国家或地区在能源出口中不同类型能源的消费组合比例
words.ex: The country increases energy export and reduces consumption mix.
words.ex_cn: 该国增加能源出口，减少消费结构。
words.en: The composition of a country's energy sources, distinguishing between those used domestically and those sold abroad.

words.tr: phrase. 开发潜力；挖掘潜能
words.ex: He wants to tap the potential of new technology.
words.ex_cn: 他想挖掘新技术的潜力。
words.en: To utilize or develop an untapped resource, ability, or opportunity to its full capacity.

words.tr: phrase. 劳动力；劳动人口；全体劳动者
words.ex: The labour force is growing in this city.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的劳动力正在增长。
words.en: The total number of people available for work in a country or region.

words.tr: phrase. 教育部长（通常指政府中主管教育事务的高级官员）
words.ex: The education secretary minister announced new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 教育部长宣布了新的学校规定。
words.en: A government official responsible for overseeing national policies on education.

words.tr: phrase. 取而代之的将是……；他们将接替出现
words.ex: In their place would come new students.
words.ex_cn: 取而代之的将是新学生。
words.en: It would be replaced by or substituted with something else.

words.tr: phrase. 多媒体网站；包含文字、图像、音频、视频等多种媒体形式的网站
words.ex: He designs multimedia web sites for schools.
words.ex_cn: 他为学校设计多媒体网站。
words.en: Online platforms that integrate various media formats like text, audio, video, and graphics.

words.tr: phrase. 有自己的位置；有自己的一席之地
words.ex: He has his place in the team.
words.ex_cn: 他在团队中有自己的位置。
words.en: To occupy a specific position, role, or location; to be suitably placed.

words.tr: 结果是混合的；形容结果好坏参半或不一致
words.ex: The result is mixed because some students passed and some failed.
words.ex_cn: 结果不一，因为一些学生通过了，一些没有通过。
words.en: The outcome or result is varied, inconsistent, or contains both positive and negative elements.

words.tr: phrase. 有矛盾情绪的；感到复杂的（指对某事同时存在好与坏的不同感受）
words.ex: I have mixed feelings about the new job.
words.ex_cn: 我对这份新工作感觉复杂。
words.en: A state of having both positive and negative emotions about a situation or person.

words.tr: 短语. 完全生效；充分起作用
words.ex: The medicine took full effect after two hours.
words.ex_cn: 这种药两小时后完全生效了。
words.en: The complete impact or consequence of something.

words.tr: phrase. 连锁反应；涟漪效应；由初始事件引发的一系列逐渐扩散的影响
words.ex: The small mistake had ripple effects on the whole project.
words.ex_cn: 这个小错误对整个项目产生了连锁反应。
words.en: The indirect and often widespread consequences of an event or action, spreading out like ripples in water.

words.tr: phrase. 期望的效果；想要达到的效果
words.ex: The medicine had the desired effect on his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对他的疼痛产生了预期的效果。
words.en: The intended or hoped-for result of an action or policy.

words.tr: phrase. 已提出的立法；拟议中的法规
words.ex: The government introduced a proposed legislation to reduce pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府提出了一项减少污染的法案。
words.en: A draft law or bill that has been formally presented to a legislative body for consideration.

words.tr: phrase. 外来务工人员；流动工人；移民劳工
words.ex: Migrant workers often move from rural areas to cities in search of better job opportunities.
words.ex_cn: 农民工经常从农村地区迁移到城市寻找更好的工作机会。
words.en: Migrant workers are people who move from one place to another, especially from one country to another, in order to find work.

words.tr: phrase. 留守在家的儿童（指因父母外出务工等原因而留在原居住地、由他人代为照顾的儿童）
words.uk: steɪ ət həʊm lɛft bɪˈhaɪnd ˈtʃɪldrən
words.us: steɪ ət hoʊm lɛft bɪˈhaɪnd ˈtʃɪldrən
words.ex: Many stay-at-home left-behind children live with their grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 许多留守儿童与祖父母一起生活。
words.en: Children whose parents have migrated to cities for work, leaving them in rural hometowns, often with grandparents.

words.tr: phrase. 相亲角（指公园或公共场所中父母为子女张贴相亲信息、寻找对象的特定区域）
words.ex: They met in the match-making corner at the community center.
words.ex_cn: 他们在社区中心的相亲角相遇了。
words.en: A designated area, often in a newspaper or online, where people seek romantic partners.

words.tr: n. 媒人；撮合者
words.ex: She is a match-maker for her friends.
words.ex_cn: 她是为朋友牵线搭桥的人。
words.en: A person who arranges or facilitates introductions between people, especially for romantic purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 人际关系；人与人之间的联系与互动
words.ex: Good interpersonal relationships can significantly improve workplace harmony.
words.ex_cn: 良好的人际关系可以显著提高工作场所的和谐度。
words.en: Interpersonal relationships refer to the social associations, connections, or affiliations between two or more people. These relationships can vary in levels of intimacy and sharing, implying the discovery or establishment of common ground, and may be centered around something(s) shared in common.

words.tr: phrase. 高层管理；上层管理人员
words.ex: Upper management approved the new budget.
words.ex_cn: 高层管理批准了新的预算。
words.en: The senior executives and leaders who make strategic decisions in an organization.

words.tr: phrase. 一种家的感觉；归属感；安心舒适的感受
words.ex: She feels a sense of home in her small kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 她在小厨房里感到家的感觉。
words.en: A feeling of comfort, belonging, and security associated with a place or situation.

words.w: bamboo ceilingesp.in america,the stop of promotion to asian ppl.
words.tr: phrase. 竹子天花板；指在美国职场中亚裔人士在晋升到高层管理职位时所面临的无形障碍
words.ex: Many Asian professionals hit a bamboo ceiling in America and cannot get promoted.
words.ex_cn: 许多亚裔专业人士在美国遭遇了竹天花板，无法获得晋升。
words.en: An invisible barrier in corporate environments, particularly in the U.S., that prevents Asian employees from advancing to senior leadership positions.

words.tr: phrase. 玻璃天花板，尤指女性在职业晋升中遇到的无形障碍
words.ex: She broke the glass ceiling for women in her company.
words.ex_cn: 她为公司里的女性打破了玻璃天花板。
words.en: An invisible barrier in a workplace that prevents women or minorities from rising to higher positions.

words.tr: phrase. 职业奉献精神；专业敬业态度
words.ex: He shows professional dedication by working late every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天熬夜工作，表现出职业上的奉献精神。
words.en: The commitment and diligence shown by an individual towards their work or profession.

words.tr: phrase. 人类的存在与发展
words.ex: The existence and development of mankind depend on clean water and food.
words.ex_cn: 人类的生存与发展依赖于清洁的水和食物。
words.en: The state and progress of human life and society over time.

words.tr: phrase. 不良影响；副作用
words.ex: The medicine has an adverse effect on his stomach.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对他的胃有不良影响。
words.en: An adverse effect is an unwanted side effect or a negative outcome resulting from a particular action or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 养老金制度；退休金体系
words.ex: The pension system in many countries is under financial strain.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家的养老金制度正面临财务压力。
words.en: A pension system is a mechanism by which individuals accumulate savings during their working lives and draw upon them after retirement.

words.tr: phrase. 老年护理职业；从事照顾老年人工作的职业生涯
words.ex: He chose the career of elderly care to help older people.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了老年护理这个职业来帮助老年人。
words.en: The field of work focused on providing care and support to older people.

words.tr: phrase. 市场监管机构；负责制定并执行市场规则、监督市场行为以维护公平竞争与秩序的制度性组织
words.ex: The market regulation institution checks prices to protect buyers.
words.ex_cn: 市场监管机构检查价格以保护买家。
words.en: An organization or system that oversees and controls economic activities to ensure fairness and stability.

words.tr: phrase. 市场活力；市场的生机与活跃度
words.ex: The new policy aims to enhance market vitality by reducing taxes.
words.ex_cn: 新政策旨在通过减税来增强市场活力。
words.en: The energy and capacity for growth or sustained success in a market, often reflected in the level of economic activity and innovation.

words.tr: phrase. 合法权益
words.ex: The law protects people's legitimate rights and interests.
words.ex_cn: 法律保护人民的合法权利和利益。
words.en: Legal and ethical entitlements and benefits that belong to an individual or group.
